input: tpm2_eventlog YAML version 1 plus the exact binary event-log artifact
semantics: EventNum is preserved as canonical source sequence and must be strictly increasing
EV_NO_ACTION is non-extending and may omit digest_sha256
PCR0 StartupLocality is detected from the StartupLocality event payload and is surfaced as startup_locality
PCR0 HCRTM events are preserved and left for the replay profile to classify as unsupported initial-state adjustment
the adapter never selects a SHA-1 or SHA-384 digest as a SHA-256 digest
missing or ambiguous SHA-256 digests on extending events are DENY
observed SHA-256 PCR values are parsed separately from the final pcrs section
the exact binary event-log digest and adapter source digest are emitted into the canonical input
unsupported: ambiguous duplicate SHA-256 digests within one event
